# Anti-patterns — Tier 2

Wrong code beside right code (docs/skills.md §3), from the linter's own corpus under `apps/_lint/`: for each rule the file that fails it and the file that passes it, headers stripped. `privatium lint` reports the left column and accepts the right.

## `PV101` — app.toml parses and carries slug, title, version, api, tier

error · `spec/app-contract.md §3`

**Wrong** (`apps/_lint/fail/PV101/pv101bad/app.toml`):

```toml
[app]
slug  = "pv101bad"
title = "Lint PV101"
tier  = "lua"
```

**Right** (`apps/_lint/pass/PV101/pv101ok/app.toml`):

```toml
[app]
slug    = "pv101ok"
title   = "Lint PV101"
version = "1.0.0"
api     = 1
tier    = "lua"
```

## `PV108` — No UNIQUE constraint or index beyond id's primary key

error · `spec/app-contract.md §4.5`

**Wrong** (`apps/_lint/fail/PV108/pv108bad/app.lua`):

```lua
local pv = require 'privatium'

pv.get('/', function()
  return pv.render('index', {})
end)
```

**Right** (`apps/_lint/pass/PV108/pv108ok/app.lua`):

```lua
local pv = require 'privatium'

pv.get('/', function()
  return pv.render('index', {})
end)
```

## `PV205` — Declared [permissions] beyond the defaults carry a justifying comment

warn · `spec/app-contract.md §5.4`

**Wrong** (`apps/_lint/fail/PV205/pv205bad/app.toml`):

```toml
[app]
slug    = "pv205bad"
title   = "Lint PV205"
version = "1.0.0"
api     = 1
tier    = "lua"

[permissions]
sql = true
```

**Right** (`apps/_lint/pass/PV205/pv205ok/app.toml`):

```toml
[app]
slug    = "pv205ok"
title   = "Lint PV205"
version = "1.0.0"
api     = 1
tier    = "lua"

[permissions]
sql = true  # the settings page offers an ad-hoc query box
```

## `PV206` — No innerHTML with non-literal data in Tier 2 JavaScript

error · `spec/app-contract.md §5.4`

**Wrong** (`apps/_lint/fail/PV206/pv206bad/web/app.js`):

```js
import { pv } from '/static/pv.js';

const out = document.getElementById('out');
const node = await pv.node();
out.innerHTML = '<b>' + node.name + '</b>';
```

**Right** (`apps/_lint/pass/PV206/pv206ok/web/app.js`):

```js
import { pv } from '/static/pv.js';

const out = document.getElementById('out');
const node = await pv.node();
out.textContent = node.name;
```

## `PV207` — No external origin referenced without a matching permissions.remote entry

error · `spec/app-contract.md §5.4`

**Wrong** (`apps/_lint/fail/PV207/pv207bad/web/app.js`):

```js
const out = document.getElementById('out');
const response = await fetch('https://api.example.com/today');
out.textContent = await response.text();
```

**Right** (`apps/_lint/pass/PV207/pv207ok/web/app.js`):

```js
const out = document.getElementById('out');
const response = await fetch('https://api.example.com/today');
out.textContent = await response.text();
```

## `PV208` — No apparent secret in schema.sql, app.toml, or sample data

error · `spec/protocol.md §3`

**Wrong** (`apps/_lint/fail/PV208/pv208bad/sample/seed.jsonl`):

```json
{"op":"put","tbl":"person","id":"01J6ZK2Q000000000000000ADA","d":{"name":"Ada","password":"hunter2"}}
```

**Right** (`apps/_lint/pass/PV208/pv208ok/sample/seed.jsonl`):

```json
{"op":"put","tbl":"person","id":"01J6ZK2Q000000000000000ADA","d":{"name":"Ada"}}
```

## `PV301` — No literal /a/<slug>/ path — use url() or pv.url() (breaks solo mode)

error · `spec/app-contract.md §2.2`

**Wrong** (`apps/_lint/fail/PV301/pv301bad/app.lua`):

```lua
local pv = require 'privatium'

pv.get('/', function() return pv.render('index', {}) end)
pv.post('/save', function() return pv.redirect('/a/pv301bad/') end)
```

**Right** (`apps/_lint/pass/PV301/pv301ok/app.lua`):

```lua
local pv = require 'privatium'

pv.get('/', function() return pv.render('index', {}) end)
pv.post('/save', function() return pv.redirect(url('/')) end)
```

## `PV304` — Client code does not set seq, lam, ts, dev, or app on an event

error · `spec/data-api.md §2`

**Wrong** (`apps/_lint/fail/PV304/pv304bad/web/app.js`):

```js
import { pv } from '/static/pv.js';

await pv.append([{ op: 'put', tbl: 'stroke', id: pv.ulid(), d: { points: [] }, seq: 1, ts: new Date().toISOString() }]);
```

**Right** (`apps/_lint/pass/PV304/pv304ok/web/app.js`):

```js
import { pv } from '/static/pv.js';

await pv.append([{ op: 'put', tbl: 'stroke', id: pv.ulid(), d: { points: [] } }]);
```

## `PV305` — No outbox dedupe table, transaction ID, or acknowledgement protocol

warn · `spec/protocol.md §10.6`

**Wrong** (`apps/_lint/fail/PV305/pv305bad/app.lua`):

```lua
local pv = require 'privatium'

local seen_txid = {}

pv.get('/', function() return pv.render('index', { seen = seen_txid }) end)
```

**Right** (`apps/_lint/pass/PV305/pv305ok/app.lua`):

```lua
local pv = require 'privatium'

local seen = {}

pv.get('/', function() return pv.render('index', { seen = seen }) end)
```

## `PV401` — No icon-only control without a label argument or aria-label

error · `docs/icons.md`

**Wrong** (`apps/_lint/fail/PV401/pv401bad/views/index.lsp`):

```html
<h1>Notes</h1>
<a class="pv-btn" href="<?= url('/edit') ?>"><?= icon('pencil') ?></a>
<svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M0 0h16v16H0z"/></svg>
```

**Right** (`apps/_lint/pass/PV401/pv401ok/views/index.lsp`):

```html
<h1>Notes</h1>
<a class="pv-btn" href="<?= url('/edit') ?>"><?= icon('pencil', 'Edit the note') ?></a>
<svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M0 0h16v16H0z"/></svg>
```

## `PV402` — Every form input has an associated <label for>

error · `spec/cli.md §5.1`

**Wrong** (`apps/_lint/fail/PV402/pv402bad/views/index.lsp`):

```html
<h1>Search</h1>
<form method="get" action="<?= url('/') ?>">
  <input id="q" name="q" type="search" placeholder="Search">
  <button type="submit">Go</button>
</form>
```

**Right** (`apps/_lint/pass/PV402/pv402ok/views/index.lsp`):

```html
<h1>Search</h1>
<form method="get" action="<?= url('/') ?>">
  <label for="q">Search</label>
  <input id="q" name="q" type="search">
  <button type="submit">Go</button>
</form>
```

## `PV404` — Heading levels do not skip; exactly one <h1> per rendered page

warn · `spec/cli.md §5.1`

**Wrong** (`apps/_lint/fail/PV404/pv404bad/views/index.lsp`):

```html
<? if rows then ?>
  <h1>Notes</h1>
  <h3>Recent</h3>
<? end ?>
```

**Right** (`apps/_lint/pass/PV404/pv404ok/views/_board.lsp`):

```html
<? if not node then ?>
  <h1>Nothing yet</h1>
<? else ?>
  <h1><?= node.text ?></h1>
<? end ?>
```

## `PV406` — Declared colour tokens meet 4.5:1 body / 3:1 large and UI

warn · `spec/cli.md §5.1`

**Wrong** (`apps/_lint/fail/PV406/pv406bad/static/app.css`):

```css
:root { --fg: #999999; --bg: #ffffff; }
body { color: var(--fg); background: var(--bg); }
```

**Right** (`apps/_lint/pass/PV406/pv406ok/static/app.css`):

```css
:root { --fg: #1d2129; --bg: #ffffff; --accent: #00274c; }
body { color: var(--fg); background: var(--bg); }
:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); }
```

error · `spec/protocol.md §6.1`

**Wrong** (`apps/_lint/fail/PV501/pv501-a-long-slug-x/app.toml`):

```toml
[app]
slug    = "pv501-a-long-slug-x"
title   = "Lint PV501"
version = "1.0.0"
api     = 1

```

**Right** (`apps/_lint/pass/PV501/pv501-a-long-slug-x/app.toml`):

```toml

title   = "Lint PV501"
version = "1.0.0"
```

## `PV504` — No CDN reference — libraries are vendored under web/vendor/

error · `spec/app-contract.md §5.1`

**Wrong** (`apps/_lint/fail/PV504/pv504bad/web/index.html`):

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Lint</title>
<main>
  <h1>Lint</h1>
  <p id="out" role="status"></p>
</main>
<script src="https://cdn.example.com/lib.min.js"></script>
<script type="module" src="app.js"></script>
</html>
```

**Right** (`apps/_lint/pass/PV504/pv504ok/web/index.html`):

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Lint</title>
<main>
  <h1>Lint</h1>
  <p id="out" role="status"></p>
</main>
<script type="module" src="app.js"></script>
</html>
```
